title: Missing Access Control on collectYield() Allows Anyone to Steal Fees
description: The `collectYield()` function has no access control modifier but transfers collected V4 pool fees directly to `msg.sender`. This allows any external caller to steal all accumulated trading fees from the V4 liquidity position.
impact: Any external attacker can call this function and steal all accumulated trading fees from the V4 liquidity position. Complete loss of yield revenue.
attackPath: Attacker monitors the protocol for accumulated trading fees in the V4 liquidity position
Attacker calls collectYield() directly on UniV4StableYieldStrategy
Function collects fees from V4 pool and transfers them to msg.sender (the attacker)
Attacker receives all accumulated yield that should belong to depositors
recommendation: Add `onlyOwner` or `onlyAuthorizedWithdrawer` modifier to `collectYield()` to restrict who can collect and receive the accumulated fees.
